verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of role-based permissions, role definitions, or ways to restrict investigation or administrative actions to specific roles. The only related item is a list of SAML SSO and SCIM configuration guides. SSO and SCIM handle identity and user provisioning, which is an adjacent control, not documented role-scoped authorization, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can restrict investigation and administrative actions to appropriate roles
